upheld.title: Page-count formula duplicated by the new clamp
upheld.detail: The PR adds a second copy of `(int)Math.Ceiling(1.0 * Count / PageSize)` in OnInitializedAsync (lastPage, :211) next to the existing markup copy (totalPages, :93). The clamp and the pager must agree on the last page, but they compute it separately.
upheld.requirement: pr-check-style 'What to check' 2: no duplicated logic

dismissed.title: Redundant `current` alias of the new currentPage field
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. `var current = currentPage;` keeps the pager markup diff small, so keeping or dropping it is a preference, not a defect.

dismissed.title: Restrict the overflow fallback to positive page numbers
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. Verified: for page=-2147483648, `currentPage - 1` wraps to int.MaxValue, so the guard requests page index 0 and shows first-page products where the grid used to be empty; the pager shows the negative page both before and after. The ticket defines no behaviour for page number
